ValidationRule.description: Restrict Legal Approve value Approve/ Rejected without Approved or Rejected Date
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(OR(ISPICKVAL( Legal_Approval__c , 'Approved'), ISPICKVAL( Legal_Approval__c , 'Rejected')), OR( ISNULL( Approved_Rejected_Date__c ), Approved_Rejected_Date__c > TODAY(), Approved_Rejected_Date__c < Approval_Submission_Date__c ))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The Approved/Rejected Date cannot be a future date or null, please verify.
